args.title: Neutralise CSV exports for descriptions starting with special characters
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

CSV exports should neutralise text values that start with '=', '+', '-', or '@', to prevent them from being treated as formulas when opened in Excel or Google Sheets. This change will ensure that descriptions do not trigger formula interpretation in spreadsheet applications.
